description: A board that is not its own box. O on the top left and X on the bottom right turns, a quarter clockwise, into the box ..O...X.. -- the smallest of its eight turns as text. That box is its own mirror on the other diagonal, so squares 0 and 8, 1 and 5, 3 and 7 are each one move, and only 0, 1, 3 and 4 hold beads. A bead drawn in the box is played on the square of the real board that the turn put there.

cases.name: the fourth bead of seven is on box square 3, which is the real board's square 7
the first bead is on box square 0, the real board's square 6
the centre is the centre whichever way the board is turned
